what: Decoder map for the packed live build of DIY Cleaners. Kept in GitHub only; excluded from the published site via _config.yml.
packing: The app <script> body is the readable source's <script> body, UTF-8 then base64, stored as window.__A and run with indirect eval. CSS is whitespace-minified; HTML is unchanged.
decode: atob(__A) -> UTF-8 bytes -> text  (e.g. Python: base64.b64decode(__A).decode('utf-8'))
